name: Research and write answers with two subagents on different models
description: An orchestrator agent with the Task Tool and two subagents. A researcher subagent on Claude Haiku gathers facts as short bullets, and a writer subagent on Claude Sonnet turns them into a clear answer for Java developers. The orchestrator never answers research questions itself.
shortDescription: An orchestrator delegates research to a cheap subagent and writing to a stronger one.
keyFeatures: AI Agent with the Task Tool and two Subagent Tools
Each subagent has its own model and instructions
Cheap model for research, stronger model for the final answer
idealFor: Teams that want to split agent work by cost and quality, and anyone learning multi-agent patterns.
steps: Trigger: a message arrives in the workflow chat.
Research and write: the orchestrator calls the researcher subagent, then passes its findings to the writer subagent.
Reply: the writer's answer is sent back to the chat.
